name: VISTA Pathways to Health Careers, formerly Medical Career Collaborative (MC2)
org: Denver Health with Children's Hospital Colorado
city: Denver metro and Colorado Springs, CO
what_you_do: A health careers program for juniors and seniors. You do a paid internship of 100 to 120 hours at Denver Health or Children's Colorado. You also join weekly classes and earn small health certificates.
who_can_apply: Current high school sophomores who can legally work in the U.S. You must commit to two years and not plan to graduate early. Denver Health's page says Denver metro schools. Children's Colorado's page says Denver metro or Colorado Springs schools.
pay_detail: Paid internship at Colorado minimum wage or more. No exact rate is listed.
duration: Junior and senior years; 100 to 120 hour paid internship in junior year
deadline_text: Denver Health's page says the 2027 to 2028 VISTA application opens in mid January 2027 and closes in early March 2027. Children's Colorado's page says its MC2 application is closed and opens at the start of each year.
how_to_apply: Check both pages in January 2027. Children's Colorado says one form covers its sites. A team reads your essays, GPA and 1 recommendation. They also look at student need. Some students get an interview.
notes: The two pages disagree. Denver Health says MC2 is now VISTA and is only at Denver Health. Children's Colorado still lists MC2 at Denver Health and sites in Aurora, Broomfield, Highlands Ranch and Colorado Springs. Ask before you apply: marisa.valeras@dhha.org, 303-602-2685 or mc2applications@childrenscolorado.org.
